panels.art: Tense two-shot in a dead-end stone alley behind the market: Dan at the left, Mira at the right facing him, both out of breath. The song has gone silent; on a rusty nail in the wall between them hangs a scrap of frayed vermilion thread, the same as Mira's cord. One flickering ochre lantern, cold teal darkness at the far end.

lines.ru: Тупик за рынком. Песня стихла. На ржавом гвозде — обрывок красной нити, точь-в-точь как у Миры на запястье.

lines.en: Lina is your sister, Mira.
lines.ru: Лина — твоя сестра, Мира.
lines.delivery: quiet certainty, gently confronting her, the dawn of understanding in his voice

lines.en: I hear nothing. But yes.
lines.ru: Я ничего не слышу. Но да.
lines.delivery: low flat voice, wary admission, hiding pain

panels.art: Quiet two-shot in a tiny round niche room with ochre scratched walls and a bare hanging lamp with a vermilion-hearted flame: Mira at the right sits with her back to the wall and her knees up, eyes on the floor; Dan at the left sits cross-legged, listening. Warm, fragile light.

lines.ru: Мира говорит быстро и ровно — как человек, который много раз рассказывал это самому себе.

lines.en: I tell you the true story. It is not good.
lines.ru: Я расскажу тебе правдивую историю. Она нехорошая.
lines.delivery: low steady voice, heavy and honest, preparing to tell a painful story

panels.art: Memory scene in warm sepia paper tones. Wide shot of a tiny cramped family kitchen: young Mira (the same look, three years younger) at the left and her 14-year-old sister Lina with two loose braids at the right sit close together at a small table, two cups, a small window with soft light; the other two chairs are empty. A faint red cord on each girl's left wrist.

lines.en: Lina and me. Our mother is gone. Our father is gone.
lines.ru: Мы с Линой. Нашей мамы нет. Нашего папы нет.
lines.delivery: soft low memory voice, tired and wistful, a sad story told in a warm kitchen

lines.en: She is my family. I am her family.
lines.ru: Она моя семья. Я её семья.
lines.delivery: gentle quiet fierce love, a small proud whisper, her voice softer than ever

panels.art: Memory scene in warm sepia paper tones. Medium shot in the kitchen: on the plain wall a wooden door has grown out of nowhere, a single faint vermilion glow shape (abstract, no letters) around its frame; Lina at the right reaches for its handle with a curious smile; young Mira at the left sits at the table, seen half from behind, watching.

lines.en: A door comes. Lina opens it. She is a child. She loves doors.
lines.ru: Приходит дверь. Лина открывает её. Она ребёнок. Она любит двери.
lines.delivery: quiet warm sad voice, fond memory fading into dread, almost smiling

panels.art: Memory scene in warm sepia paper tones. Medium tracking shot in a narrow Tower corridor: Lina at the right walks ahead with her chin up, singing with her mouth open; young Mira at the left hurries behind her with a finger raised to her own lips. Faint vermilion sparks float overhead.

lines.en: A child sings. She loves songs. She is loud. I say: be quiet.
lines.ru: Ребёнок поёт. Она любит песни. Она громкая. Я говорю: тише.
lines.delivery: low regretful voice, smiling faintly then grim, remembering a hard sentence

panels.art: Memory scene in warm sepia paper tones. Dramatic close shot on two hands in the foreground drifting apart, fingers sliding, both slightly blurred so that it is impossible to tell which hand opened first; behind them, out of focus, young Mira on her knees at the left, Lina pulled back at the centre, and a tall faceless Silent looming at the right.

lines.en: They come. I have no breath. They take the child. They take all her words.
lines.ru: Они идут. У меня нет дыхания. Они забирают ребёнка. Они забирают все её слова.
lines.delivery: sharp trembling voice, quick and horrified, memory of loss, controlled grief

lines.ru: Две руки расходятся. Чьи пальцы разжались первыми — на этом рисунке не разобрать.

lines.en: Then I am alone.
lines.ru: И я остаюсь одна.
lines.delivery: small hollow voice, flat and numb, the loneliness of the story's end

panels.art: Two-shot in the niche room: Dan at the left leans forward with elbows on his knees, listening hard; Mira at the right stares at the lamp, her jaw tight, one hand gripping the red cord on her left wrist. The lamp's vermilion-hearted flame flickers.

lines.en: And the Keeper?
lines.ru: А Хранитель?
lines.delivery: quiet careful question, soft and sympathetic

lines.en: I go to him. He has a map to the last door. It is not free.
lines.ru: Я иду к нему. У него есть карта к последней двери. Она не бесплатная.
lines.delivery: low bitter, controlled voice, a hard trade remembered

panels.art: Memory scene in warm sepia paper tones. Wide shot of the huge round Hall of Words with shelves of glowing jars: the Keeper (hood hiding his eyes, only a calm small smile visible) at the centre draws a single glowing vermilion thread out of young Mira's chest with his ink-stained fingertips; Mira at the left, pale and rigid. The red cord on her wrist dims. The System window floats at the right.

lines.en: One word, whole. I give you the map.
lines.ru: Одно слово, целиком. Я даю тебе карту.
lines.delivery: calm velvety unsettling voice, silky and slow, a generous smile hiding a trap

lines.en: Word lost: ...
lines.ru: Слово потеряно: ...
lines.delivery: cold flat system notice, whispered, ominous trailing off

lines.ru: Даже в собственной памяти Мира не слышит, какое слово у неё забрали.

panels.art: Close two-shot in the niche room: Mira at the right looks straight at Dan with hard honest eyes; Dan at the left listens, the lamp flame between them. The System window hovers at the top centre, its border steady.

lines.en: Lina waits at the last door. It needs a sentence.
lines.ru: Лина ждёт у последней двери. Ей нужно предложение.
lines.delivery: quiet honest voice, serious and steady, no longer hiding

lines.en: Nobody here can make one. We buy words and use them one by one.
lines.ru: Здесь никто не может его составить. Мы покупаем слова и используем их по одному.
lines.delivery: low tired explanation, dry and bleak, a little bitter

lines.en: True.
lines.ru: Правда.
lines.delivery: short dry system confirmation, flat and cool

panels.art: Close-up two-shot, eye level: Mira at the right speaks without looking away; Dan at the left slowly understands, eyes widening behind the taped glasses. The lamp's warm light cuts across both faces.

lines.en: The Keeper tells me: wait for a Zero. A Zero learns his words. He can open that door.
lines.ru: Хранитель говорит мне: жди Зеро. Зеро учит свои слова. Он может открыть ту дверь.
lines.delivery: low flat voice, quoting the Keeper's words slowly, with a bitter edge

lines.en: So you wait for me.
lines.ru: Значит, ты ждала меня.
lines.delivery: stunned quiet voice, hurt rising under calm, a slow sad realization

lines.en: I wait three years. I don't tell you. That is a lie too.
lines.ru: Я жду три года. Я не говорю тебе. Это тоже ложь.
lines.delivery: honest low voice, ashamed but steady, voice heavy with guilt

panels.art: Tense two-shot, slightly low angle: Dan at the left has stood up, fists clenched, stricken and angry; Mira at the right stays seated, looking up at him, unflinching. The niche walls are scratched with names.

lines.en: You don't help me. You use me.
lines.ru: Ты мне не помогаешь. Ты меня используешь.
lines.delivery: hurt and angry, rising voice, shaking with betrayal

lines.en: Yes. I use you. Lina is my family.
lines.ru: Да. Я использую тебя. Лина — моя семья.
lines.delivery: hard honest voice, steady, refusing to look away, pain in each word

lines.en: One day. Then I am gone. Zero is useful.
lines.ru: Один день. Потом я уйду. Зеро полезен.
lines.delivery: bitter echo, quoting her old words back at her, voice breaking

lines.en: It is true. I don't lie to you now.
lines.ru: Это правда. Сейчас я тебе не вру.
lines.delivery: quiet raw honesty, tired and sorry, softer than ever

panels.art: Action two-shot in the niche room: Dan at the left shouts with one arm thrown out, Mira at the right on her feet shouts back, both leaning into each other; between and above them the System window with a solid vermilion border and inverted colours (a warning). The lamp flame leans sideways as if from the noise.

lines.en: My name! My OPEN! You know his price!
lines.ru: Моё имя! Моё OPEN! Ты знала его цену!
lines.delivery: furious ragged shout, anguished, pouring out everything he has bottled up

lines.en: I tell you: don't talk to him! He is bad for us!
lines.ru: Я говорила: не говори с ним! Он плох для нас!
lines.delivery: sharp frightened shout, fierce and cracking, trying to hold on

lines.en: My mom calls me! You lie! I am not your key!
lines.ru: Мне звонит мама! Ты лжёшь! Я не твой ключ!
lines.delivery: broken furious shout, tears in his voice, angry and heartsick

lines.en: Quiet. They hear you.
lines.ru: Тише. Они слышат вас.
lines.delivery: cold flat system warning, low and urgent

panels.art: Medium shot in the soot-dark corridor from behind Mira at the right: Dan at the left walks away from her into the corridor, his back to the viewer, fists in his pockets. Mira has taken half a step and stopped, one hand outstretched, her feet visibly unable to follow. The niche's warm lamp glow behind her.

lines.en: I am not your friend. Find your door alone.
lines.ru: Я тебе не друг. Ищи свою дверь одна.
lines.delivery: cold tight voice, flat anger masking hurt, walking away

lines.en: Zero. Wait.
lines.ru: Зеро. Подожди.
lines.delivery: faint strained plea, small and helpless, almost a whisper

lines.en: He is not my friend. He is my key. Then why can't I run?
lines.ru: Он мне не друг. Он мой ключ. Тогда почему я не могу бежать?
lines.delivery: small shaky inner voice, confused ache, hardly believing her own feelings

lines.ru: Мира хочет побежать за ним — и не может. Там, где было слово, теперь дыра: она не умеет удерживать своих.

panels.art: Quiet medium shot in the corridor: Dan at the left sits on the floor with his back against the wall, knees up, glasses pushed up on his forehead, rubbing his eyes; the System window floats at the right at his eye level, small and dim.

lines.en: You are alone. That is a bad plan.
lines.ru: Ты один. Это плохой план.
lines.delivery: flat dry system observation, quiet and a touch teasing

lines.en: True. Her plan is bad too. A friend does not use a friend.
lines.ru: Верно. Её план тоже плохой. Друг не использует друга.
lines.delivery: tired low voice, a bitter small laugh, honest and thoughtful

lines.en: Missed calls: 11.
lines.ru: Пропущенные звонки: 11.
lines.delivery: flat quiet system count, sad and soft

lines.en: Mom. I love you. I never say it to you.
lines.ru: Мама. Я люблю тебя. Я никогда тебе этого не говорю.
lines.delivery: tender broken inner whisper, a quiet confession, voice shaking with love

panels.art: Close two-shot at hip height: a small child-sized Silent (1.4 m, with a frayed vermilion cord on its left wrist) at the right has taken Dan's sleeve between two thin pale fingers and tugs it; Dan at the left looks down at it, caught between fear and tenderness.

lines.en: Come.
lines.ru: Иди.
lines.delivery: thin hollow child-like voice, soft and small, a single gentle word

lines.en: Lina? I am not Mira. Mira is there.
lines.ru: Лина? Я не Мира. Мира там.
lines.delivery: gentle surprised whisper, cautious and kind, speaking to a child

lines.en: Come. You.
lines.ru: Иди. Ты.
lines.delivery: thin hollow child-like voice, soft and insistent, small hand reaching out

panels.art: Dark low-angle shot: in a black wall a narrow slit of red light splits the dark; the small Silent in the centre points one thin arm toward it, Dan at the left looks at the slit, and the System window with a solid vermilion border floats at the right.

lines.en: Look.
lines.ru: Смотри.
lines.delivery: hushed hollow whisper, eerie and quiet, drawing him into the dark

lines.en: Warning. This place is not on her map.
lines.ru: Предупреждение. Этого места нет на её карте.
lines.delivery: grave cold system alarm, hushed and ominous

lines.ru: Она ведёт его не к сестре. Она ведёт его туда, куда три года водила пальцем по камню.

grammarNote.title: my, your, his, her, our и me, him, her, us, them
grammarNote.body: Слова my (мой), your (твой), his (его), her (её), our (наш) стоят перед существительным и показывают, чьё оно: my name, her words, our mother. Слова me, him, her, us, them стоят после глагола и отвечают на вопрос «кого?»: You use me. They take her. Заметь, что her бывает двух видов: her family — «её семья», They take her — «забирают её».

options: Он учит слова и может составить предложение для двери

quiz.q: Кто увёл Дэна в конце серии?
